description: Notify trace-mcp that a file was edited. Reindexes the single file and invalidates search caches. Call after Edit/Write to keep index fresh — much lighter than full reindex. Also flags duplicate symbols — if `_duplication_warnings` appears, you may be recreating existing logic; review them. Each one is reported once per file, not on every edit; `check_duplication` re-asks. Mutates the index; idempotent. Returns JSON: { status, file, totalFiles, indexed, _duplication_warnings? }.

file_path.description: Relative path to the edited file

name: register_edit
